- [Quasar Quality Gates](.ai-rulez/domains/frontend/skills/quasar-quality-gates/SKILL.md): Domain frontend. Run Quasar prepare, vue-tsc typecheck, and lint across the four apps (pos, erp, hr, ledger) before any push or tag. Use for validation failures and pre-push checks.
- [NixOS Host Deploy](.ai-rulez/domains/nixos-clan/skills/nixos-host-deploy/SKILL.md): Domain nixos-clan. Validate, build, provision, and SSH-deploy NixOS clients (client1 Hyper-V, client2 VPS, client3 local) with post-deploy diagnostics. Use for host deploys and deploy failures.
- [Web & Backend Release](.ai-rulez/domains/nixos-clan/skills/web-backend-release/SKILL.md): Domain nixos-clan. Ship Nix SPA images, the Frappe backend image, and bench scaffolds to GHCR with auto-tags and releases. Use for image builds, release cuts, and release failures.
